title: Find photos in subfolders and see folder counts
notes: Empty current folders offer Show photos in subfolders using the existing persisted Recursive display mode. Folder rows lazily show direct supported-photo counts with a bounded cache; partial scans show a + suffix. The library header shows matching/total photo counts before grouping and labels recursive views. Counts run off the UI thread with two workers and bounded scans; the old folder-count setting now only controls album totals. New labels use English fallback wording.
